Welp

25 Jul 2026 - strawberryjam

Welp, knowing my shitty luck.. we knew I'd be back..

I am no longer with my boyfriend.

It's not healthy, but I find it very difficult to be single.. I just need to feel chosen, need to feel I can share something with someone all day long ><

I need a man to handle my shitty status updates all day long lollll~ like oh I'm drinking tea now. oh I went to the museum! oh I'm eating a sammich now

holy cow do I sound so unbearable..

This bf... he used to read my blog and one time I posted something very distressing and he was the only person that noticed and consoled me. It meant a lot to me. I don't think he reads this anymore ;_; I truly love him though ;_; and don't think I can forget him :(

The good news is a lot has changed in the positive direction in my life on the whole... I finally started my egl brand this year. It's very small, but I've been doing in person markets! I'll be starting an online shop soon. So please stay tuned!

I'm very proud to have gotten into some higher caliber events in such a short time too. I really hope my brand can deliver cute things for you ><

We used to have home pages.. and webpages all about us. Somehow we traded it for endless scrolling and instantaneously likes.

Does anyone miss the lost art of blogging?

Somehow I feel like lolita and blogging go hand in hand. There are so many activities you do as a lolita such as tea time - enjoying simple sandwiches and pouring tea for yourself, it's not a practical meal you have quickly. It's a meal you take time with and you think and absorb what's going on around you.

And blogging is a slowed down activity too. You take time to think about what you want to say and prepare accompanying pictures. You can make a long statement for people to really get your message. You don't just post pictures and get likes right away.

I miss when you just shared content you liked... not for likes or clout, but just because.

Hm, I forgot to announce that I'm in my sweet lolita era now! Here's a picture of me in Angelic Pretty's Wonder Party. It's sooo cute ><

Got back into Eurobeat idols again :sweat: Some melancholy feeling to this song... fitting cos it's called "I love you" and I just broke up lol.

p.s. I am honestly really struggling with this break up :((((
